resources.string: Namaz Akışı: Uko igihe cy’iswala gihagaze
Namaz Akışı: Ikibaye ku gihe cy’iswala
Iri genamiterere ryongerwa muhereye kuri porogaramu y’ibikorwa byikora
Mushakisha ntizishobora guhabwa uruhushya ruhoraho. Mubyongere muhereye ku rutonde rw’inyongera rwa porogaramu nka Tasker, MacroDroid cyangwa Automate.
Mubyongere muhitamo «Namaz Akışı» ku rutonde rw’inyongera rwa porogaramu nka Tasker, MacroDroid cyangwa Automate.
Mwari mwarabujije iyi porogaramu kwemeza iswala zanyu. Mushobora kuyemerera muri Namaz Akışı muri Igenamiterere > «Porogaramu zemeza Nasali».

%1$s ishobora kumenya igihe cy’iswala gitangiye, igihe kigiye kurangira n’igihe muri ku musigiti, maze igakoresha ibikorwa byanyu byikora. Mushobora guhindura icyemezo cyanyu muri Namaz Akışı muri Igenamiterere > «Porogaramu zemeza Nasali».
%1$s ishobora kwemeza ko iswala y’iki gihe yasaliwe ikoresheje igikorwa cyikora mwashyizeho. Mushobora guhindura icyemezo cyanyu muri Namaz Akışı muri Igenamiterere > «Porogaramu zemeza Nasali».
Igihe icyo ari cyo cyose cy’iswala
